At the lower-left point is labeled angle 1; the two sides of angle 1 are respectively the chord from the lower-left point connected to the upper-left point, and the chord from the lower-left point connected to the right-side point. The upper arc between the upper-left point and the right-side point is labeled 96°. Reasoning: Angle 1 is an inscribed angle, and the arc it intercepts is the arc from the upper-left point to the right-side point, whose arc measure is 96°. According to the inscribed angle theorem, the measure of an inscribed angle is equal to half the measure of the arc it intercepts, so m∠1 = 96° ÷ 2 = 48°.
